meta.revisionPolicy: Section 42 figures are provisional, then final; sectoral credit is provisional and revised the next month; NPAs and capital ratios are final on release. Seams disclosed, never joined: the 2019 sectoral classification, the July 2023 HDFC merger, the December 2025 reporting calendar.
meta.coverage: Classification of loan assets by bank group, as the RBI publishes the totals: standard, sub-standard, doubtful and loss advances and gross NPAs, amounts and shares, every March since 2004
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 665 (data provider DP0), read from the local Data Bank mirror, as published. One display unit kept (ACTUALS). Amounts in ₹ crore.
